title: Clean-team protocol breach during pre-close sensitive-data work
notes: Design §B.4: immediate halt with legal-counsel involvement — gun-jumping exposure (pre-close exchange of competitively sensitive information outside the clean-team protocol; EC fines up to 10% of revenue is the statutory ceiling, ILLUSTRATIVE as a planning prior). Declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design; a breach is an auditable event, not a snapshot variable, so the executable form (if any) depends on how breaches come to be recorded (activation convention per ADR-0057).
